
---
name: Cleanup Request
about: Request cleanup, refactoring, or code quality improvements
title: "[Cleanup]: "
labels: help wanted
assignees: ''
---

**What needs cleanup?**
Describe the area of the codebase or project that requires cleanup, refactoring, or improvement.

**Why is cleanup needed?**
Explain why this cleanup is important — e.g., improving maintainability, reducing technical debt, aligning with standards, etc.

**What should be the result?**
Describe the expected outcome after cleanup. For example: simplified logic, better naming, improved performance, etc.

**Are there any dependencies or risks?**
List anything that might affect the cleanup, such as features depending on the current implementation or risky areas of the code.

**Additional notes or resources**
Include references to related issues, pull requests, or documentation that support or explain the need for this cleanup.
